section.title: Project layout
section.rule: All server code lives under server/. Do not place application packages at repo root.
Prefer layers: server/app/api/, application/, domain/, adapters/, config/. Cross-cutting logging may live under server/app/logging/ or shared utils.

RAG corpus docx files are local-only under the path from DOCS_CORPUS_PATH (default server/docs/) or DOCS_DIR; the corpus directory is gitignored and must not be committed. Rules/context live under server/ and server/rules/ — not at repo root.
Tests under server/tests/ mirroring app packages (tests/api, tests/application, tests/adapters, tests/integration).

Project artifacts (project_context.md, semantic_graph.xml, dev_plan.xml, rules/, README.md, .env.example) live under server/. Repo root README only points to server/. Do not reintroduce duplicates at repo root.

section.title: LangGraph and LangChain
section.rule: Dialogue orchestration uses LangGraph StateGraph under server/app/application/dialogue/.
Graph nodes call our ports (LLMClient, EmbeddingsClient, VectorStore, etc.) via DI — never hard-code Http*.
Do not use LangChain RetrievalQA, LCEL RAG chains, or LangChain vectorstore/docling wrappers as the primary RAG path.
langchain-core is optional for message types only. Prefer domain Message models for persistence and API DTOs.
Pin modern langgraph (and langchain-core if used) in pyproject.toml; graph topology must not depend on concrete adapters.

section.title: Python style and typing
section.rule: Target Python 3.12+ (3.13 if environment supports). Use modern syntax: list[], | unions, match where clear.
Full type hints on public functions; Pydantic v2 models for API and settings.
Formatter/linter: ruff. Typecheck: mypy or pyright — fail on untyped adapter boundaries.
Async by default for I/O (FastAPI endpoints, httpx, DB if async driver). CPU-bound soffice may use thread pool.
Identifiers, modules, JSON field names in English. User-facing message strings may be Russian.
No wildcard imports. Explicit __all__ only when defining a public package API.

section.title: Dependency policy
section.rule: Declare dependencies in server/pyproject.toml. Pin compatible ranges; prefer latest stable majors known good for FastAPI, Pydantic v2, httpx, qdrant-client, langgraph (optional langchain-core), SQLAlchemy 2.x, asyncpg, alembic.
Do not add heavy ML stacks into the API process unless required; call remote Docling/embeddings/LLM via adapters.
Dev/test extras: pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff, httpx (ASGI). Keep CI lean.

section.title: API conventions
section.rule: Prefix /api/v1. Consistent error body: { "detail": ..., "code": "SNAKE_CASE" }.
Use plural resources: /appeals, nested /appeals/{id}/messages.
Side-effectful learning action: POST /appeals/{id}/officer-reply (not a silent message append).
Return citation objects on grounded answers; never omit when message_kind=answer.
HTTP status: 201 create; 404 missing appeal; 409 illegal status transition; 422 validation.

section.title: Adapter naming and factories
section.rule: Protocols/ABCs named without implementation prefix (e.g. LLMClient, EmbeddingsClient, VectorStore).
Real implementations: HttpLLMClient, HttpEmbeddingsClient, QdrantVectorStore, HttpDoclingClient, SofficeLibreOffice, EmailEscalationNotifier, SqlAlchemyPersistence (PostgreSQL).
Construction only via factory/DI reading Settings. Application services must not import Http* / Qdrant* directly.
Product runtime uses real adapters only. Tests mock ports or HTTP; never ship fake provider adapters in app/.

section.title: Error handling
section.rule: Map adapter failures to domain/application errors; do not leak raw upstream bodies with secrets.
Timeouts from env (*_TIMEOUT_S) must be enforced on httpx clients.
Escalation path on grounding failure is a business outcome (200/201 with escalation message), not a 500.

section.title: Domain purity
section.rule: domain/ has no FastAPI, httpx, or qdrant imports.
Grounding and dialogue policies live in application/ (or domain services) — not in routers.

section.title: PostgreSQL persistence
section.rule: PostgreSQL is the system of record for appeals, messages, escalations, audit, and stats inputs. Data must survive process restarts.
Real adapter: SQLAlchemy 2.x async + asyncpg. Migrations via Alembic. Connection string: DATABASE_URL.
Naming: SqlAlchemyPersistence (or PostgresPersistence). Unit tests mock the Persistence port.
Application services depend on the Persistence port only — never import sqlalchemy in routers or LangGraph node modules directly.
Keep CLIENT_INFO.md response shapes aligned when changing persisted API fields.
